data.name: Ranjika
data.gender_notes: Ranjika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ranja' meaning joy and 'Ka' meaning beautiful. It is a name that signifies the joy and radiance of life, and the beauty of the soul. The name Ranjika carries the meaning “Joyful, Radiant, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ranjika usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, radiant, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Ranjika belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful, Radiant, Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ranjika total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_sanskrit.name: रान्जिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rājikā (राजिका) - राज (rāj) meaning ‘rule, reign, or king’, and का (kā) meaning ‘female’, so Rājikā means ‘Lady, Queen, or Lady of the Grove’. The name Ranjika comes from this Sanskrit root.

in_hindi.name: रांजिका
in_hindi.long_meaning: Rānjikā (राञ्जिका) - रान्ज (rānj) meaning ‘pleasing’ or ‘delighting’, and का (kā) meaning ‘female’, so Rānjikā means ‘She who pleases with the grove’ or ‘She who delights in the grove’. The name Ranjika comes from this Hindi root.

in_tamil.name: ராஞ்சிகா
in_tamil.long_meaning: Rāñcikā (ராஞ்சிகா) - ராஞ்சி (rāñci) meaning ‘grove, wood, or forest’, and கா (kā) meaning ‘female’, so Rāñcikā means ‘Lady of the Grove’ or ‘She who resides in the grove’. The name Ranjika may also be transliterated as Randhika in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: రాఞ్జిక
in_telugu.long_meaning: Rāñjiki (రాఞ్జికి) - రాఞ్జ (rāñja) meaning ‘pleasing’ or ‘delighting’, and కి (ki) meaning ‘female’, so Rāñjiki means ‘She who pleases’ or ‘She who delights’. The name Ranjika may also be transliterated as Randhiki in Telugu.
